GET STARTED

From your account to your next upgrade

  1. Download and extract. For Windows, extract the full portable ZIP and keep the executable with its accompanying files.
  2. Enter your current levels. Use Edit current levels, then enter your Guardian Points and hourly income.
  3. Try a build. Adjust levels directly, or enter your goals in Target optimizer.
  4. Review and save. Check the cost and ETA, then save the distribution as a preset.

This fan-made tool plans upgrades; it does not change your game account. Features and installation instructions are documented in the project README. Future cost projections may be marked speculative in the tool’s documentation.
